1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.297 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B, 328
Ipc & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Biswan, District Sitapur.

3. In terms of the Fir registered through an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C., it was alleged
that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 27.06.2021 and

entities.text: Suneeta @ Susheela @ Badaki vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 

sufficient dowry was also given, however, the matrimonial family was not satisfied with the dowry and subsequently on 29.03.2022, the daughter of the informant was killed by the matrimonial family.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant draws my attention to the postmortem report which records one contusion injury on the upper eyelid and the cause of death as per the analysis of the viscera is Organophosphorus Insecticide.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the postmortem report coupled with the fact that general allegations have been levelled against the entire matrimonial family and there being nothing specific against the applicant,
who is mother-in-law, to suggest that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any mental or physical harassment in relation to demand of dowry as well as the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 04.11.2023, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Suneeta @ Susheela @ Badaki be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
